calls.statement:
SELECT f.vat_rate, p.vat_class, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) nd, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount) vat, sum(f.net_amount*f.vat_rate) calc_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period=5 AND s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) rl, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at),
 sum(CASE WHEN sale_date<DATE '2024-09-01' AND vat_rate=0.255 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) early255,
 sum(CASE WHEN sale_date>=DATE '2024-09-01' AND vat_rate=0.24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late24,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount-net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) badgross,
 sum(CASE WHEN channel_code='WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wb, sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'

WITH l AS (SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date, sum(f.net_amount) n FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT store_id, business_date, net_sales_before_returns b, returns_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND store_id<900)
SELECT count(*) rows_, sum(l.n) lines_net, sum(r.b) rpt_net, sum(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(l.n,0)-coalesce(r.b,0))>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch_rows, sum(r.returns_net) rpt_returns
FROM l FULL JOIN r ON l.store_id=r.store_id AND l.sale_date=r.business_date

calls.statement:
SELECT f.vat_rate, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(r.refund_gross) refund_gross, sum(r.refund_gross-r.refund_net) refund_vat
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, p.category='ZZ Test' AS test, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount) vat
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND (s.store_id>=900 OR p.category='ZZ Test') GROUP BY 1,2
